reports.title: Lilly reports third-quarter 2026 financial results, raises full-year guidance and highlights regulatory progress across the portfolio

guidance.heading: 2026 Financial Guidance
section: In addition to providing guidance for GAAP revenue, Lilly provides guidance for certain non-GAAP measures.

The following table summarizes the company's updated full-year 2026 non-GAAP financial guidance, reflecting strong underlying performance across our portfolio. The first three quarters of 2026 also benefited from sales-based milestones and adjustments to estimates for rebates and discounts.

In addition to updates to Revenue and Performance Margin guidance, EPS guidance has been adjusted to reflect an increase of $4.07 (at the midpoint of the range), offset by $4.57 associated with the Q3 acquired IPR&D charges from recent business development activity:

Prior | Updated
Revenue | $85 to $87 billion | $91 to $92 billion
Performance Margin(1)(2) | 49.0% to 50.5% | 52.0% to 52.5%
Tax Rate(1)(3) | 18% to 19% | 19% to 20%
Earnings per Share(1)(3)(4) | $35.50 to $36.50 | $35.00 to $36.00
